title: Spiced Algerian Quinoa Bowl
description: A hearty and flavorful quinoa bowl inspired by Algerian cuisine, packed with spicy and aromatic flavors.
instructions: Rinse the quinoa in a fine mesh strainer and cook according to package instructions.
Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add the chopped onions and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the diced carrots and cook for 5 minutes, or until they start to soften.
Add the yellow tagine and Algerian spice blend. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 20-25 minutes, or until the carrots are tender.
Fluff the cooked quinoa with a fork and serve the tagine mixture over the top.
Garnish with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
